item.title: New pickleball, tennis, basketball courts coming to Wilson Park
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- New pickleball, concrete basketball and tennis courts are coming to Wilson Park by June. City officials said the replacement project started Monday, March 2. The replacement project was made possible by Measure N. Officials said Measure N funds were also used to replace playground equipment.
